Title: ChatOptions - Chat Role Configuration
Summary: Configuration class for chat message roles. Defines standard roles (System, Assistant, User, Tool) and display-only log roles (LogInfo, LogSuccess, LogWarn, LogError). Controls which messages are persisted.
Content:
## ChatOptions

**Namespace**: `Cyrena.Options`
**Assembly**: `Cyrena.Core`

### Purpose
Configure roles for the chat. Defines standard Semantic Kernel roles and custom display-only log roles.

### Constructors
```csharp
public ChatOptions(); // Default constructor with standard roles
public ChatOptions(AuthorRole system, AuthorRole assistant, AuthorRole user, AuthorRole tool, 
                   AuthorRole info, AuthorRole success, AuthorRole warn, AuthorRole error);
```

### Properties
| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `System` | `AuthorRole` | System role |
| `Assistant` | `AuthorRole` | Assistant role |
| `User` | `AuthorRole` | User role |
| `Tool` | `AuthorRole` | Tool role |
| `LogInfo` | `AuthorRole` | Display-only info log role |
| `LogSuccess` | `AuthorRole` | Display-only success log role |
| `LogWarn` | `AuthorRole` | Display-only warning log role |
| `LogError` | `AuthorRole` | Display-only error log role |
| `IncludeLogsInDisplay` | `bool` | Whether log messages appear in display history (default: true) |
| `MessagePersistRoles` | `AuthorRole[]` | Which roles are persisted to storage (default: [Assistant, User, Tool]) |

### Default Behavior
- Standard constructor initializes all roles with default names
- `MessagePersistRoles` defaults to `[Assistant, User, Tool]`
- System messages are NOT persisted by default
- Log roles are display-only and not sent to the LLM

### Extension Methods
- `ChatOptionsExtensions.IsDisplayContent(ChatMessageContent)` - Checks if a message should be in display history
- `ChatOptionsExtensions.IsKernelContent(ChatMessageContent)` - Checks if a message should be in kernel history

### Usage
```csharp
var options = new ChatOptions();
options.MessagePersistRoles = [options.Assistant, options.User]; // Don't persist tool messages
options.IncludeLogsInDisplay = false; // Hide log messages from user
```

### Related
